title: tongriyaotxt/screen-use
summary: browser-use, but for the entire desktop — give any AI Agent eyes and hands on Windows. MCP + SDK, VLM-optional, with visual loop, introspection and meta-learning.

title: Grevix/aura
summary: Hardware-aware memory-budget enforcement & LLM inference orchestration for low-RAM laptops. Run 7B models under a strict 4GB budget without OOM crashes.

title: pierreprudh/KLIDE
summary: Local-first agent IDE for steering Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and local models with visible review.

title: dirmacs/ares
summary: Agentic Runtime Extensible Server. A composable AI agent runtime in Rust based on the Cordis framework

title: ceyhundurden/llmhole
summary: LLMHole - an intentionally vulnerable AI/LLM lab. bWAPP-style challenges for the OWASP LLM Top 10. Runs offline with no API key; optional Live Arena against a local model via Ollama.

title: nhannht/maquette
summary: Drop a photo, get a sculpted 3D model. Mac-native BYOK loop: a coder LLM writes Three.js geometry, a vision LLM judges it against your photo, the best cycle exports GLB + USDZ.

title: Peuqui/AIfred-Intelligence
summary: 🤵 AIfred-Intelligence — self-hosted Multi-Agent Assistant with Debate Modes (Symposion/Tribunal), Voice (STT + Streaming-TTS), RAG with Long-Term Memory, Web Research and Tool-Calling. Reachable via Web-UI or Telegram/Discord/Email/EPIM. Multi-Backend: llama-swap, Ollama, vLLM, TabbyAPI.

title: hoornet/home-mind
summary: OSS AI memory layer for Home Assistant (AGPL). The conversation server inside the Nives addon was forked from this project — they're independent now.

title: hoornet/nives
summary: AI assistant with persistent memory for Home Assistant. Voice & text via Assist, plain-language automations with confirm-first previews, one-click add-on install. Cloud or bring your own key.

title: chenyumo166/moziAI-35B-A3B-MOE-MTP-Uncensored
summary: MoziAI-35B: Local open-source financial AI LLM. 35B MoE model compressed to 15.5GB via MoziSmartBit quantization. 256K context, vision, tool calling, 140+ tok/s on consumer GPU. Based on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.

title: Phobetore/Evermind
summary: Self-hosted immersive AI roleplay. You bring the model, local or hosted. Evermind keeps a long-term memory that holds the story together, and leaves the rules to you.

title: sreekar2403/hive
summary: Hive - Multi-agent orchestration framework that routes prompts to AI CLI harnesses (opencode, Claude Code, pi) with keyword-based routing, retry loops,  and permission management. TypeScript/Express REST API + Next.js React client. MVP implementation focused on core orchestration logic

title: themayursinha/verity-trust-copilot
summary: Self-hosted compliance automation with AI-powered questionnaire answering, public Trust Center, and continuous AWS/GitHub monitoring. BYOK — supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral, Ollama, and 10+ LLM providers.

title: sasuke39/openwarp
summary: Run your own LLM inside Warp — local adapter for any OpenAI-compatible provider

title: KazKozDev/cbt-assistant
summary: Open-source local-first AI mental health chatbot and CBT journal powered by Ollama, with RAG, session memory, mood and sleep tracking, self-assessments, and guided SOS exercises.

title: artherahq/aria-code
summary: Terminal-first AI financial agent — runs fully offline via Ollama, 19+ cloud LLM providers, live market data, and a built-in quant research engine.

title: NaustudentX18/ofh
summary: Open Forest Harness (OFH) — a fully independent, provider-agnostic Android agent harness built from scratch. Pure-Kotlin agent loop, OpenAI-compatible client, tool registry, WebView chat UI.
